question.text: A heavy nucleus having mass number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn></math> gets disintegrated into smaller fragments of mass number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>80</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>120</mn></math>.
